sections.name: Large Party Subs and Platters
items: Most common types are: Italian Combo - Salami, Pepperoni, Cappicola and Provolone cheese, with lettuce and tomato, and the American Combo – Roast Beef, Turkey, Ham and American cheese, with lettuce and tomato. Party Subs come in sizes 3, 4, 5 and 6 feet. Three foot sub will feed 10-14 people. Six foot sub will feed 22-28 people. Made with Boar's Head brand deli meats.
